4
Wiase adamfofa
1 # 1 Pe 2.11 Ɛhe na akasakasa ne ɔko a ɛwɔ mo mu no fire? Ɛmfiri mo akɔnnɔ a ɛne mo honam akwaa ko no mu anaa? 2Mo kɔn dɔ, na monnya. Modi awu na mo ani bere, na montumi nnuru ho. Moko na motu sa, nanso monnya, ɛfiri sɛ mommisa. 3Mobisa na monnya, ɛfiri sɛ mobisa no bɔne, sɛdeɛ ɛbɛma moahwere no mo anigyedeɛ mu. 4#Luk 6.26; Rom 8.7; 1 Yoh 2.15 Awaresɛefoɔ, monnim sɛ wiase adamfofa ne ɔtane a wɔtane Onyankopɔn? Enti obiara a ɔpɛ sɛ ɔyɛ wiase adamfoɔ no gyina hɔ sɛ Nyankopɔn tamfo. 5#Eks 20.3; 20.5; Mat 6.24 Anaasɛ mosusu sɛ atwerɛ no kasa kwa, sɛ: Ɔtwe ne honhom a ɔte yɛn mu no ho ninkunu? 6#Mmb 3.34; Hiob 22.29; Mat 23.12; 1 Pe 5.5 Nanso ɔma adom bebree mmom. Enti na atwerɛ no se:
Onyankopɔn si ahantanfoɔ kwan,
na ɔdom ahobrɛasefoɔ.
7 # Efe 6.12; 1 Pe 5.8-9 Enti momfa mo ho nhyɛ Nyankopɔn ase. Mommɔ mo ho mmɔden nsi ɔbonsam kwan, na ɔbɛdwane afiri mo nkyɛn. 8#Sak 1.3; Yes 1.16 Mommɛn Onyankopɔn, na ɔbɛbɛn mo. Monhohoro mo nsa, mo nnebɔneyɛfoɔ, na monte mo akoma mu, mo a mo adwene yɛ ntanta! 9Monni abooboo, na mo werɛ nho, na monsu! Mo sereɛ nnane awerɛhoɔ, na mo anigyeɛ nnane anatoɔ! 10#1 Pe 5.6 Mommrɛ mo ho ase Awurade anim, na ɔbɛma mo so.
Wɔbara bu a wɔbu afoforɔ atɛn
11Anuanom, monnnidi mo ho nsekuro! Deɛ ɔdi onua ho nsekuro na ɔbu ne nua atɛn no, ɔdi mmara ho nsekuro na ɔbu mmara atɛn. Na sɛ wobu mmara atɛn a, na wonyɛ mmara no yɛfoɔ, na mmom woyɛ ne temmufoɔ. 12#Mat 7.1; Rom 2.1; 14.4 Ɔbaako ne mmarahyɛfoɔ ne ɔtemmufoɔ, ɔno ne deɛ ɔbɛtumi agyeɛ na wasɛeɛ. Na hwan ne wo a wobu obi atɛn?
Ɔkyena a wɔde hoahoa wɔn ho
13 # Mmb 27.1 Na afei mo ɛ! Mo a moka sɛ: Ɛnnɛ ne ɔkyena yɛbɛkɔ sɛɛ ne sɛɛ kuro yi mu akɔdi hɔ afe, na yɛatɔ atɔn na yɛanya mfasoɔ. 14#Luk 12.20 Nanso monnim deɛ ɛbɛba ɔkyena. Na mo nkwa ne deɛn? Ɛfiri sɛ moyɛ huhuro a ɛyi ne ho kakra, na afei ɛyera. 15#Aso 18.21 Na mmom anka ɛsɛ sɛ moka sɛ: Sɛ Awurade pɛ na yɛnya nkwa a, yɛbɛyɛ yei anaa yei. 16Na afei mohoahoa mo ho mo ahupoo mu. Saa ahohoahoa yi nyinaa yɛ bɔne. 17#Luk 12.47 Enti deɛ ɔnim papayɛ na ɔnyɛ no, ɛyɛ bɔne ma no.

pageProps.chapterText:
Ɛhe na akasakasa ne ɔko a ɛwɔ mo mu no fire? Ɛmfiri mo akɔnnɔ a ɛne mo honam akwaa ko no mu anaa? Mo kɔn dɔ, na monnya. Modi awu na mo ani bere, na montumi nnuru ho. Moko na motu sa, nanso monnya, ɛfiri sɛ mommisa. Mobisa na monnya, ɛfiri sɛ mobisa no bɔne, sɛdeɛ ɛbɛma moahwere no mo anigyedeɛ mu. Awaresɛefoɔ, monnim sɛ wiase adamfofa ne ɔtane a wɔtane Onyankopɔn? Enti obiara a ɔpɛ sɛ ɔyɛ wiase adamfoɔ no gyina hɔ sɛ Nyankopɔn tamfo. Anaasɛ mosusu sɛ atwerɛ no kasa kwa, sɛ: Ɔtwe ne honhom a ɔte yɛn mu no ho ninkunu? Nanso ɔma adom bebree mmom. Enti na atwerɛ no se:
Onyankopɔn si ahantanfoɔ kwan,
na ɔdom ahobrɛasefoɔ.
Enti momfa mo ho nhyɛ Nyankopɔn ase. Mommɔ mo ho mmɔden nsi ɔbonsam kwan, na ɔbɛdwane afiri mo nkyɛn. Mommɛn Onyankopɔn, na ɔbɛbɛn mo. Monhohoro mo nsa, mo nnebɔneyɛfoɔ, na monte mo akoma mu, mo a mo adwene yɛ ntanta! Monni abooboo, na mo werɛ nho, na monsu! Mo sereɛ nnane awerɛhoɔ, na mo anigyeɛ nnane anatoɔ! Mommrɛ mo ho ase Awurade anim, na ɔbɛma mo so.

Anuanom, monnnidi mo ho nsekuro! Deɛ ɔdi onua ho nsekuro na ɔbu ne nua atɛn no, ɔdi mmara ho nsekuro na ɔbu mmara atɛn. Na sɛ wobu mmara atɛn a, na wonyɛ mmara no yɛfoɔ, na mmom woyɛ ne temmufoɔ. Ɔbaako ne mmarahyɛfoɔ ne ɔtemmufoɔ, ɔno ne deɛ ɔbɛtumi agyeɛ na wasɛeɛ. Na hwan ne wo a wobu obi atɛn?

Na afei mo ɛ! Mo a moka sɛ: Ɛnnɛ ne ɔkyena yɛbɛkɔ sɛɛ ne sɛɛ kuro yi mu akɔdi hɔ afe, na yɛatɔ atɔn na yɛanya mfasoɔ. Nanso monnim deɛ ɛbɛba ɔkyena. Na mo nkwa ne deɛn? Ɛfiri sɛ moyɛ huhuro a ɛyi ne ho kakra, na afei ɛyera. Na mmom anka ɛsɛ sɛ moka sɛ: Sɛ Awurade pɛ na yɛnya nkwa a, yɛbɛyɛ yei anaa yei. Na afei mohoahoa mo ho mo ahupoo mu. Saa ahohoahoa yi nyinaa yɛ bɔne. Enti deɛ ɔnim papayɛ na ɔnyɛ no, ɛyɛ bɔne ma no.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
